# `contest` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "contest" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/contest/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required |  |
| `name` | string | required | The contest’s name. |
| `notes` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `entry` | object | required | Who may enter and what it costs. |
| `entry.fee` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Gold paid to enter. |
| `entry.when` | object | — | Condition (logic DSL) to be let in. Omit: anyone. |
| `entry.when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `entry.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Applied with the fee as the player enters. |
| `entry.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `participants` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The rivals; the player is always entered. |
| `participants[].id` | id | required | Id of the participant in this contest; events name it as `actor`. |
| `participants[].name` | string | required | Shown in the standings. |
| `participants[].creature` | ref → creature | — | The NPC competing, when there is one. |
| `participants[].pace` | object | — | Scores on its own at this pace. Omit: scored only by reported events. |
| `participants[].pace.everyTicks` | integer ≥ 1 | required | Ticks between scores. |
| `participants[].pace.points` | integer ≥ 1 | required | Points per score. |
| `participants[].pace.spread` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | Up to this many extra points, drawn from the seeded stream. |
| `scoring` | list of object (at least 1) | required | How events turn into points. |
| `scoring[].event` | string | required | The sim event the rule listens for, as reported to the runner. |
| `scoring[].where` | map of string → string or number or boolean | `{}` | Fields the event data must equal, e.g. `{ "targetTag": "gull" }`. |
| `scoring[].points` | integer | required | Added to the actor. |
| `scoring[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `finish` | object | required | When it ends. |
| `finish.firstTo` | integer ≥ 1 | — | Ends the moment anyone reaches this score. |
| `finish.afterTicks` | integer ≥ 1 | — | Ends this many ticks after it starts. |
| `win` | object | required | The player placed. |
| `win.placement` | integer ≥ 1 | `1` | Placing this high or better wins. |
| `win.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Prizes and reputation. |
| `win.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `lose` | object | required | The player did not place, or forfeited. |
| `lose.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | What losing gracefully earns. |
| `lose.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `disqualified` | object | — | The player was disqualified. |
| `disqualified.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | On top of whatever the cheat itself costs. |
| `disqualified.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `cheats` | list of object | — | Ways to cheat. Cheating is always possible and always has a consequence. |
| `cheats[].id` | id | required |  |
| `cheats[].event` | string | required | The sim event the rule listens for, as reported to the runner. |
| `cheats[].where` | map of string → string or number or boolean | `{}` | Fields the event data must equal, e.g. `{ "targetTag": "gull" }`. |
| `cheats[].when` | object | — | Extra condition (logic DSL) that must hold as it happens. |
| `cheats[].when.kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `cheats[].observedBy` | list of ref → creature (at least 1) | required | Creatures who would catch it. The first that perceives the event does. |
| `cheats[].bonusPoints` | integer ≥ 0 | `0` | What the cheat is worth to the player; voided on disqualification. |
| `cheats[].detected` | object | required | What happens when a watcher perceives it. |
| `cheats[].detected.disqualify` | boolean | `true` | Remove the player from the contest. |
| `cheats[].detected.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | — | Applied when it is caught (a fine, a grudge). |
| `cheats[].detected.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `cheats[].undetected` | object | required | What a cheat nobody saw still costs. |
| `cheats[].undetected.effects` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Applied when the contest ends and nobody caught it: cheating always has a consequence. |
| `cheats[].undetected.effects[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `cheats[].note` | string | — | A note for writers; never shown to players. |
| `betting` | object | — | The betting book. |
| `betting.book` | ref → creature | required | Who runs the book. |
| `betting.onPlayer` | object | — | A stake on the player winning, paid at fixed odds. |
| `betting.onPlayer.minStake` | integer ≥ 1 | required |  |
| `betting.onPlayer.maxStake` | integer ≥ 1 | required |  |
| `betting.onPlayer.odds` | object | required | Winnings are stake x numerator / denominator (rounded down), plus the stake back. |
| `betting.onPlayer.odds.numerator` | integer ≥ 1 | required |  |
| `betting.onPlayer.odds.denominator` | integer ≥ 1 | required |  |
| `betting.throwMatch` | object | — | The book pays the player to lose. |
| `betting.throwMatch.payout` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Applied when the player loses (a clean loss). |
| `betting.throwMatch.payout[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
| `betting.throwMatch.grudge` | list of object (at least 1) | required | Applied when the player wins, or is disqualified, instead. |
| `betting.throwMatch.grudge[].kind` | string | required | The logic kind, e.g. "gold". |
